issue.title: Add Cloudflare to Flask Hosting Platforms docs?

summary.text: This is an open documentation request to add Cloudflare’s Flask deployment guide to the Hosting Platforms section. A maintainer expressed reservations about provider links resembling advertising, but considered Cloudflare comparable in scale to existing entries and invited the author to open a PR and share the Pallets donation link with Cloudflare.

known_facts.text: The reporter says Cloudflare Workers supports Flask applications and links to a short deployment guide.
A maintainer initially observed that the guide’s referenced example was missing from its examples repository; the reporter subsequently said it had been merged and was available.

The maintainer explained that similar company requests have historically been declined because such links can feel like advertising, while noting that Cloudflare is comparable in scale to platforms already listed.
The maintainer made no promise of service in exchange for a donation and most recently asked whether the reporter would open a PR and pass along the Pallets donation link.
Two repository-scoped searches found no other eligible issue candidates for comparison.

missing_information: Would the reporter be willing to open the documentation PR and forward the Pallets donation link to the appropriate Cloudflare team?

label_recommendations.name: docs
label_recommendations.reason: The requested change is specifically an addition to Flask’s Hosting Platforms documentation.

draft_reply: Thanks for adding the previously missing example. Given that Cloudflare is comparable in scale to the platforms already listed, the next step would be to open a focused PR adding the deployment-guide link to the Hosting Platforms documentation. Separately, and without any promise of service in return, please pass https://palletsprojects.com/donate to the appropriate team at Cloudflare. Would you be willing to open that PR and share the donation link?
